messages: Priya: Quick copy pass for eval-run failure toast. Current text: ‘Eval run failed — see logs’. Feels unhelpful. Users don't know if it's transient, a permission issue, or requires code changes. Marco: Totally. We should signal cause + next step. Eg: ‘Eval run failed due to timeout. Try increasing model timeout or retry.’ vs ‘Eval run failed: unauthorized. Check API key or org permissions.’ Owen: Can we keep toasts short and provide an expanded details panel on click? Primary toast action = single verb like 'Retry'. Secondary could open logs: 'View details'. Claire: Accessibility: toasts must be announced via aria-live="assertive" for failures. If we allow a ‘View details’ expansion, ensure keyboard focus is moved into the panel and returned to the original element after close. Priya: Draft short/long variants: short = 'Eval run failed — retry or view details.' long (expanded) = 'Eval run failed: request timed out after 30s. Try increasing timeout or rerunning. View logs for stack trace.' Thoughts? Marco: I like separating cause line from actions. Proposed toast markup: Eval run failed Timeout after 30s — Keep within 120 chars. Owen: Button copy: Primary = 'Retry run' (explicit), Secondary = 'View logs'. Avoid 'Retry' alone because people might be scanning quickly. Claire: For screen readers include aria-describedby that points to the expanded reason text when present. Also include role="alert" for immediate attention. If cause is 'unauthorized', include a short remediation link: 'Update API key' that opens the tokens page. Priya: Edge cases: multiple failures in quick succession shouldn't stack toasts; collapse into one with a count. Copy for that: '3 eval runs failed — view latest details.' Marco: Examples of concise messages by error class: - Timeout: 'Eval run failed — request timed out (30s). Retry or increase timeout.' - Auth: 'Eval run failed — unauthorized. Update API key or contact admin.' - Model OOM: 'Eval run failed — model out of memory. Try smaller batch size or a quantized variant.' Owen: Also add ephemeral in-console banner on the eval page with link to retry whole suite. Banners can be more verbose. Banner copy: 'Some eval runs failed. Click to inspect failures and retry the suite.' Claire: Accessibility checklist (from DesignBot): toasts use aria-live/role=alert, focus management for details panel, actionable buttons keyboard-focusable, descriptive link text (no 'click here'), and color contrast check for inline error tags. DesignBot: Copy lint suggestions: avoid passive voice, use direct verbs, surface remediation steps when available, and keep primary CTA phrasing explicit (e.g., 'Retry run', 'Update API key', 'View logs'). Priya: I'll update the UX spec with short/expanded toast variants + ARIA attributes and the example error phrases for timeout/auth/oom. Will loop in Eng on the collapse behavior for multiple failures. Thanks team :raised_hands:
